bullets.text: Palestinians in Qusra village have been told to leave their homes by Israeli troops, who are reportedly using some houses as barracks, according to the mayor.
A fast-growing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has spread to a sixth province, with a man dying in Bas-Uele after traveling from Haut-Uele.
At least 44 people have died after an overcrowded ferry capsized on Lake Kariba in Zimbabwe, with a rescue operation underway for dozens missing.
An Australian teen golfer, Jessica Bang, has died in Thailand after suffering a brain haemorrhage in early August.
A baby girl was born in the driveway of a Queensland police station after officers were flagged down by a man seeking assistance.
Donald Trump held a phone call with Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese, though details of their discussion remain undisclosed.
The US sold 30-year bonds at the highest borrowing costs since 2001, reflecting investor concerns over increasing public debt and persistent high inflation.
Emerging-market stocks reached a one-month high, driven by a resurgence in the artificial intelligence trade, indicating renewed investor optimism in the sector.
Tyson Foods Inc. announced the closure of additional beef plants as the US beefpacking industry undergoes restructuring due to a prolonged shortage of cattle.
